note: Accepted findings for a deliberately vulnerable application. Keys are location-independent fingerprints; the gate fails on any finding whose key is absent here. Never add an entry you have not observed in a real scan - regenerate instead of hand-editing keys.

findings.title: ECR Repository should use customer managed keys to allow more control
findings.justification: EXCEPTION (POLICY.md 3(b)), expires 2026-10-31. Finding: the ECR repository encrypts with the AWS-managed KMS key rather than a customer-managed key. Why not fixed now: a customer-managed key needs a key policy naming the account principal, which needs an aws_caller_identity data source, which needs real AWS credentials. This module is deliberately buildable with none - credential-free `terraform validate` and `plan` are what let CI scan it at all - so adding a CMK would trade the entire IaC scanning stage for one severity-LOW improvement. The trade-off is recorded in deploy/terraform/main.tf beside the resource. Compensating controls: encryption at rest is on and uses KMS rather than the weaker AES256 default; the repository is private with access governed by IAM; tags are immutable and scan-on-push is enabled. To close: if this module is ever pointed at a real account, add a CMK with an explicit key policy and delete this entry.
